name: FreeScoutGPT
description: Draft ChatGPT-powered replies and summaries inside conversations, with support for multiple models.
review_notes: module.json and the main service provider read cleanly; no obfuscation or undisclosed outbound calls found. This free version's module.json links to a paid "Pro" upgrade at 5starplugins.com — that's disclosed here, not hidden in the code.

name: Themes
description: Adds a handful of custom color themes for the FreeScout admin UI.
review_notes: Service provider only touches CSS/theme settings and writes its own compiled stylesheet to its own Public/css directory. No network calls, no obfuscation.

name: Discord Notifications
description: Posts new-ticket and customer-reply notifications to a Discord channel through a webhook URL you configure.
review_notes: The only outbound call is a curl POST to the admin-configured Discord webhook_url — that's the module's stated purpose, not a hidden call. No obfuscation. No license file in the repo at review time.

name: Following
description: Adds a "Following" folder that lists conversations you've chosen to follow.
review_notes: Pure database/folder-filtering logic, no network calls at all, no obfuscation.

name: LJPc calendar module
description: Adds a calendar to FreeScout with support for external ICS and CalDAV calendars.
review_notes: Only outbound calls are to ICS/CalDAV URLs an admin enters per calendar, fetched by a scheduled command -- that's the module's stated purpose. No eval, no obfuscation, no undisclosed calls.

name: HostetskiGPT
description: Drafts a GPT reply to a conversation from a thread menu button, using a per-mailbox OpenAI API key.
review_notes: Only outbound call is to OpenAI's chat completions endpoint using an admin-entered per-mailbox API key. No obfuscation, no other network or credential access.

name: Aarhus Unsub
description: Looks for unsubscribe headers on incoming messages and adds a one-click unsubscribe link to the conversation.
review_notes: The only outbound call sends a click-gated request to the URL parsed from the email's own List-Unsubscribe header -- inherent to one-click unsubscribe, not a hidden call. Some leftover debug logging, but no exfiltration.

name: Stripe
description: Shows a customer's Stripe subscriptions and invoices on their conversation profile.
license: MIT (module.json declares AGPL-3.0 -- a metadata mismatch, not a security issue)
review_notes: Only outbound calls are to Stripe's own API using an admin-entered secret key that's encrypted at rest. No obfuscation, no undisclosed calls.

name: Unassigned Count
description: Displays the number of unassigned conversations in the mailbox menu.
review_notes: Purely reads a folder count and echoes it into the mailbox menu. No network calls, no obfuscation.

name: SAML 2.0 SSO
description: Provides SAML 2.0 single sign-on for FreeScout.
review_notes: The only outbound calls are to the SSO/SLO endpoints and certificate an admin configures in the module's own settings section. No obfuscation, no undisclosed calls, no credential exfiltration.

name: seven
description: Sends SMS replies through the seven.io SMS gateway, published by seven.io itself.
review_notes: Only outbound call is to seven.io's own SMS API using an admin-entered, encrypted API key -- that's the module's disclosed purpose. No obfuscation, no other network access.

name: Fetch Seen
description: Optionally fetches already-seen mails from the mail server.
review_notes: Just an admin-gated toggle flag consumed elsewhere in FreeScout's own mail fetching. No network calls, no obfuscation.

name: Postal
description: Adds Postal (a self-hosted mail server) as an inbound mail protocol via an HTTP webhook endpoint.
license: MIT (module.json declares AGPL-3.0 -- a metadata mismatch, not a security issue)
review_notes: Registers one inbound webhook route that decodes Postal's own base64-wrapped message payload -- that's the module's stated purpose, not obfuscation. No outbound calls, no credential exfiltration.

name: Sidebar Webhook
description: Asynchronously injects HTML from your own server into conversation sidebars.
review_notes: Only outbound call is a POST to an admin-configured URL, gated behind an admin-only settings route -- that's the module's stated purpose. No obfuscation, no other network access.

name: Twilio Integeration
description: Connects Twilio SMS and MMS to FreeScout via a mailbox-configured webhook.
review_notes: Outbound calls are to Twilio's own API using an admin-entered account SID/token, plus following redirects on MMS media links Twilio itself supplies in its webhook payload. No obfuscation, no other network access.

name: Mail365
description: Send and receive emails via the Microsoft 365 Graph API instead of SMTP/IMAP.
review_notes: Only outbound calls are to Microsoft Graph API endpoints using OAuth credentials an admin configures per mailbox. No obfuscation -- a client-side JWT payload decode of its own access token, not a signature bypass.

name: Internal Conversations
description: Create internal conversations between users with support for teams and mentions.
review_notes: Pure database CRUD for team/mention-based internal conversations via standard FreeScout hooks. No network calls, no obfuscation.

name: AdamSmartSearchUI
description: Unified FreeScout search with a fast default path, opt-in message-content search, permission-safe filters, deleted-state badges, and page-only bulk actions.
review_notes: Pure database search/filtering logic, no external search API calls, no obfuscation.

name: Ticket Aging Colors
description: Adds a left-side color bar on ticket rows based on how long Active tickets have been waiting, with per-mailbox thresholds and optional breathing effect.
review_notes: Pure CSS/UI logic based on conversation timestamps already in the database. No network calls, no obfuscation.

name: OverflowAchievement
description: Gamified achievements, levels, and motivational quotes for FreeScout users.
review_notes: Quotes and achievement data are a local, static config file, not a remote API. No network calls, no obfuscation.

name: Scheduled Conversations
description: Schedule and automate recurring conversations: periodic reminders, maintenance notices, or follow-ups on daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, or yearly frequencies.
review_notes: Pure scheduling/database logic built on FreeScout's own conversation model. No outbound network calls, no obfuscation.

name: Attachment Security
description: Blocks dangerous file attachments with role-based control, customizable notifications, and audit logging.
review_notes: Shells out to unrar/archive tools to inspect attachment contents; every path is passed through escapeshellarg(), no injectable concatenation found. No obfuscation, no outbound network calls.

name: SyncNow
description: Force immediate IMAP synchronization for a single mailbox on demand, for time-sensitive cases like an expiring 2FA code.
review_notes: Launches FreeScout's own artisan fetch-emails command in the background for one mailbox, admin-gated and built with escapeshellarg()/escapeshellcmd() throughout. No obfuscation, no outbound network calls.

name: Ameise Module
description: Adds connectivity of Ameise CRM to FreeScout.
review_notes: Only outbound calls are to Ameise CRM's own hardcoded test/prod API endpoints, matching the module's stated single-vendor integration purpose -- same pattern as this catalog's Stripe/Twilio entries. No obfuscation; only useful to Ameise CRM customers.

name: Mailbox Auto-Distributor
description: Automatically assigns new mailbox conversations to a selected assignee pool using round-robin or least-open distribution.
review_notes: Pure assignment logic over FreeScout's own conversation/user models. No network calls, no obfuscation.

name: MetaWhatsApp
description: WhatsApp Business channel via Meta Cloud API.
review_notes: Only outbound calls are to Meta's own Graph API for WhatsApp Business, using an admin-configured access token -- the module's stated purpose. No obfuscation.
